teaser: A clock above a loading dock ticks through a late shift, and you are the one still there after the others clocked out. You carry life path 11, and you carry the four letters of ENTJ. The 11 asks for a kind of listening that arrives before any plan is possible; the Commander in you wants the plan already made. What is particular here is the speed: intuition lands in a flash, and this type turns a flash into an order before the flash has finished saying what it means. The result looks like certainty. It is sometimes closer to a guess, dressed fast and sent out the door.
